sentences.fr: Je suis vraiment désolé : j’ai oublié de te prévenir que la réunion avait changé d’heure.
sentences.en: I'm really sorry: I forgot to warn you that the meeting had changed time.
distractors: I'm really sorry: I forgot to warn you that the meeting had changed room.
I'm really sorry: I forgot to warn you that the meeting had been cancelled.

sentences.fr: Si tu m’avais dit que tu étais malade, je serais venu t’aider hier soir.
sentences.en: If you had told me you were ill, I would have come to help you last night.
distractors: If you had told me you were ill, I would have come to help you tomorrow evening.
If you had told me you were ill, I would have sent someone to help you last night.

sentences.fr: J’ai posté le colis lundi : ce n’est pas ma faute s’il est arrivé en retard.
sentences.en: I posted the parcel on Monday: it's not my fault if it arrived late.
distractors: I posted the parcel on Tuesday: it's not my fault if it arrived late.
I posted the parcel on Monday: it's not my fault if it arrived damaged.

sentences.fr: Elle m’a reproché de ne jamais l’écouter, alors que je l’avais attendue deux heures.
sentences.en: She blamed me for never listening to her, whereas I had waited for her for two hours.
distractors: She blamed me for never answering her, whereas I had waited for her for two hours.
She blamed me for never listening to her, whereas I had waited for her for two days.

sentences.fr: Est-ce que tu pourrais m’expliquer pourquoi tu n’as pas répondu à mes messages ?
sentences.en: Could you explain to me why you didn't answer my messages?
distractors: Could you explain to me why you didn't read my messages?
Could you explain to me why you didn't answer my calls?

sentences.fr: Il faudrait que tu appelles le propriétaire pour qu’il répare le chauffage cette semaine.
sentences.en: You should call the landlord so that he repairs the heating this week.
distractors: You should call the landlord so that he repairs the heating next week.
You should call the neighbour so that he repairs the heating this week.

sentences.fr: Mon voisin se plaint du bruit, pourtant c’est lui qui regarde la télévision à minuit.
sentences.en: My neighbour complains about the noise, yet he's the one who watches television at midnight.
distractors: My neighbour complains about the smell, yet he's the one who watches television at midnight.
My neighbour complains about the noise, yet he's the one who watches television at midday.

sentences.fr: Après une heure d’attente, le serveur nous a dit qu’il n’y avait plus de table.
sentences.en: After an hour's wait, the waiter told us there were no tables left.
distractors: After a two-hour wait, the waiter told us there were no tables left.
After an hour's wait, the manager told us there were no tables left.

sentences.fr: Je ne t’en veux pas : j’aurais préféré que tu me le dises tout de suite.
sentences.en: I'm not angry with you: I would have preferred you to tell me right away.
distractors: I'm not angry with you: I would have preferred you to tell me tomorrow morning.
I'm not angry with you: I would have preferred you to write it to me right away.

gloss.en: am angry with you (en vouloir à)

sentences.fr: Quand je suis rentrée, mon frère avait déjà tout rangé et m’attendait avec un gâteau.
sentences.en: When I got home, my brother had already tidied everything and was waiting for me with a cake.
distractors: When I got home, my sister had already tidied everything and was waiting for me with a cake.
When I got home, my brother had already tidied everything and was waiting for me with a coffee.

sentences.fr: Le vendeur refuse de me rembourser parce que j’ai perdu le ticket de caisse.
sentences.en: The salesman refuses to refund me because I lost the receipt.
distractors: The salesman refuses to exchange it because I lost the receipt.
The salesman refuses to refund me because I lost the guarantee.

sentences.fr: Excuse-moi, je crois que je t’ai envoyé ce message par erreur.
sentences.en: Sorry, I think I sent you this message by mistake.
distractors: Sorry, I think I sent you this photo by mistake.
Sorry, I think I deleted this message by mistake.

sentences.fr: Si vous n’êtes pas satisfait, vous pouvez déposer une réclamation avant la fin du mois.
sentences.en: If you are not satisfied, you can file a complaint before the end of the month.
distractors: If you are not satisfied, you can file a complaint before the end of the week.
If you are not satisfied, you can ask for a refund before the end of the month.

sentences.fr: Mes parents, qui ne se parlaient plus depuis trois ans, se sont réconciliés à Noël.
sentences.en: My parents, who hadn't spoken to each other for three years, made up at Christmas.
distractors: My parents, who hadn't spoken to each other for two years, made up at Christmas.
My parents, who hadn't spoken to each other for three years, made up at Easter.

sentences.fr: Pourriez-vous baisser la musique ? Mon fils dort et il se réveille à chaque fois.
sentences.en: Could you turn the music down? My son is asleep and he wakes up every time.
distractors: Could you turn the television down? My son is asleep and he wakes up every time.
Could you turn the music down? My daughter is asleep and she wakes up every time.

sentences.fr: Je lui ai écrit trois fois, mais il ne m’a jamais répondu.
sentences.en: I wrote to him three times, but he never answered me.
distractors: I called him three times, but he never answered me.
I wrote to him twice, but he never answered me.

sentences.fr: C’est la voisine dont je t’ai parlé : elle garde nos clés quand nous partons.
sentences.en: That's the neighbour I told you about: she keeps our keys when we go away.
distractors: That's the neighbour I told you about: she keeps our post when we go away.
That's the neighbour who helped you: she keeps our keys when we go away.

sentences.fr: Ils se sont disputés parce que personne n’avait pensé à réserver la salle.
sentences.en: They had an argument because nobody had thought of booking the room.
distractors: They had an argument because nobody had thought of booking the restaurant.
They had an argument because nobody had thought of paying for the room.

sentences.fr: Tu aurais dû me prévenir plus tôt ; maintenant il est trop tard pour annuler.
sentences.en: You should have warned me earlier; now it's too late to cancel.
distractors: You should have warned me earlier; now it's too late to pay.
You should have warned my sister earlier; now it's too late to cancel.

sentences.fr: Elle a menti à son patron, et depuis, elle a peur qu’il s’en rende compte.
sentences.en: She lied to her boss, and since then she's afraid he'll realise it.
distractors: She lied to her boss, and since then she's afraid he'll forget it.
She lied to her colleague, and since then she's afraid he'll realise it.

sentences.fr: Nous avons perdu les clés de la voiture, donc nous avons dû rentrer à pied.
sentences.en: We lost the car keys, so we had to walk home.
distractors: We lost the house keys, so we had to walk home.
We lost the car keys, so we had to go home by bus.

sentences.fr: Qu’est-ce que tu ferais si ton meilleur ami te mentait pour te protéger ?
sentences.en: What would you do if your best friend lied to you to protect you?
distractors: What would you say if your best friend lied to you to protect you?
What would you do if your brother lied to you to protect you?

sentences.fr: Le chauffage est en panne depuis samedi et le propriétaire ne rappelle toujours pas.
sentences.en: The heating has been broken since Saturday and the landlord still hasn't called back.
distractors: The heating has been broken since Sunday and the landlord still hasn't called back.
The heating has been broken since Saturday and the neighbour still hasn't called back.

sentences.fr: Je n’aurais jamais cru qu’une histoire aussi bête puisse gâcher notre amitié.
sentences.en: I would never have believed that such a silly thing could ruin our friendship.
distractors: I would never have believed that such a silly thing could ruin our holiday.
I never believed that such a silly thing could ruin our friendship.

sentences.fr: Ma sœur m’a demandé si je pouvais garder ses enfants samedi prochain.
sentences.en: My sister asked me if I could look after her children next Saturday.
distractors: My brother asked me if I could look after his children next Saturday.
My sister asked me if I could look after her children last Saturday.

sentences.fr: Il m’a rendu mon livre, mais il avait oublié d’enlever ses notes à l’intérieur.
sentences.en: He gave me back my book, but he had forgotten to take his notes out of it.
distractors: He gave me back my notebook, but he had forgotten to take his notes out of it.
He gave me back my book, but he had forgotten to take his photos out of it.

sentences.fr: Si j’étais toi, je lui enverrais un message pour m’excuser avant ce soir.
sentences.en: If I were you, I would send him a message to apologise before tonight.
distractors: If I were you, I would send him a message to apologise before tomorrow.
If I were you, I would write him a letter to apologise before tonight.

sentences.fr: Nous nous sommes trompés d’adresse : la fête avait lieu dans l’autre immeuble.
sentences.en: We got the wrong address: the party was taking place in the other building.
distractors: We got the wrong address: the party was taking place in the other street.
We got the wrong day: the party was taking place in the other building.

sentences.fr: Le voisin du dessus a inondé ma salle de bains et refuse de payer.
sentences.en: The neighbour upstairs flooded my bathroom and refuses to pay.
distractors: The neighbour upstairs flooded my kitchen and refuses to pay.
The neighbour downstairs flooded my bathroom and refuses to pay.

sentences.fr: Tant pis, on en reparlera quand tu seras plus calme.
sentences.en: Never mind, we'll talk about it again when you're calmer.
distractors: Never mind, we'll talk about it again when you're less busy.
Never mind, we'll think about it again when you're calmer.

sentences.fr: Mon collègue a pris mon rapport et l’a présenté comme si c’était le sien.
sentences.en: My colleague took my report and presented it as if it were his own.
distractors: My colleague read my report and presented it as if it were his own.
My colleague took my report and presented it as if it were finished.

sentences.fr: Je te promets que je ne recommencerai plus jamais, même si c’était un accident.
sentences.en: I promise you I'll never do it again, even if it was an accident.
distractors: I promise you I'll never do it again, even if it was your idea.
I promise your sister I'll never do it again, even if it was an accident.

sentences.fr: Elles ne s’adressent plus la parole depuis que l’une d’elles a oublié l’anniversaire de l’autre.
sentences.en: They no longer speak to each other since one of them forgot the other's birthday.
distractors: They no longer speak to each other since one of them forgot the other's wedding.
They no longer work together since one of them forgot the other's birthday.

gloss.en: speech (adresser la parole = to speak to)

sentences.fr: Franchement, je ne comprends pas ce qu’il me reproche : je n’ai rien fait de mal.
sentences.en: Honestly, I don't understand what he's blaming me for: I haven't done anything wrong.
distractors: Honestly, I don't understand what he's asking me for: I haven't done anything wrong.
Honestly, I don't understand what he's blaming me for: I haven't said anything wrong.

sentences.fr: Le serveur s’est excusé et nous a offert le dessert pour se faire pardonner.
sentences.en: The waiter apologised and offered us dessert to make up for it.
distractors: The waiter apologised and offered us a coffee to make up for it.
The manager apologised and offered us dessert to make up for it.

gloss.en: to make up for it (se faire pardonner)

sentences.fr: Est-ce que quelqu’un pourrait m’aider à porter ces cartons jusqu’au troisième étage ?
sentences.en: Could someone help me carry these boxes up to the third floor?
distractors: Could someone help me carry these boxes up to the second floor?
Could someone help me carry these suitcases up to the third floor?

sentences.fr: Il m’a raconté une histoire si étrange que personne ne l’a crue.
sentences.en: He told me such a strange story that nobody believed it.
distractors: He told me such a sad story that nobody believed it.
He told me such a strange story that nobody understood it.

sentences.fr: Quand elle a enfin avoué la vérité, tout le monde a éclaté de rire.
sentences.en: When she finally confessed the truth, everybody burst out laughing.
distractors: When he finally confessed the truth, everybody burst out laughing.
When she finally confessed the truth, everybody started crying.

sentences.fr: Je voudrais que nous en parlions calmement, sans que les enfants nous entendent.
sentences.en: I'd like us to talk about it calmly, without the children hearing us.
distractors: I'd like us to talk about it calmly, without the neighbours hearing us.
I'd like us to talk about it tomorrow, without the children hearing us.

sentences.fr: Mon fils s’est excusé auprès de son professeur, qui a accepté de ne rien dire.
sentences.en: My son apologised to his teacher, who agreed to say nothing.
distractors: My son apologised to his teacher, who refused to say anything.
My son apologised to his neighbour, who agreed to say nothing.

sentences.fr: On s’était promis de tout se dire, pourtant elle m’a caché son départ.
sentences.en: We had promised to tell each other everything, yet she hid her departure from me.
distractors: We had promised to tell each other everything, yet she hid her illness from me.
We had promised to tell each other everything, yet she hid her departure from her brother.

sentences.fr: Si tu continues à crier, personne ne voudra t’écouter.
sentences.en: If you keep shouting, nobody will want to listen to you.
distractors: If you keep shouting, nobody will want to help you.
If you keep lying, nobody will want to listen to you.

sentences.fr: Ma colocataire laisse toujours la cuisine sale, et ça finit par m’énerver.
sentences.en: My flatmate always leaves the kitchen dirty, and it ends up annoying me.
distractors: My flatmate always leaves the bathroom dirty, and it ends up annoying me.
My flatmate sometimes leaves the kitchen dirty, and it ends up annoying me.

sentences.fr: Nous nous sommes réconciliés après une longue discussion qui a duré toute la nuit.
sentences.en: We made up after a long conversation that lasted all night.
distractors: We made up after a long conversation that lasted all morning.
We separated after a long conversation that lasted all night.

sentences.fr: Elle a dit qu’elle ne viendrait pas, parce qu’elle ne supporte plus mes remarques.
sentences.en: She said she wouldn't come, because she can't stand my remarks any more.
distractors: She said she wouldn't come, because she can't stand my friends any more.
She said she would come late, because she can't stand my remarks any more.

sentences.fr: Tu te souviens du jour où tu as cassé mon vélo et accusé ton cousin ?
sentences.en: Do you remember the day when you broke my bike and blamed your cousin?
distractors: Do you remember the day when you broke my bike and blamed your brother?
Do you remember the day when you lost my bike and blamed your cousin?

sentences.fr: Je m’excuse pour le retard : il y avait un embouteillage énorme sur l’autoroute.
sentences.en: I'm sorry for being late: there was a huge traffic jam on the motorway.
distractors: I'm sorry for being late: there was a huge traffic jam in the city centre.
I'm sorry for the noise: there was a huge traffic jam on the motorway.

sentences.fr: Il paraît que leur dispute a commencé pour une histoire de vaisselle.
sentences.en: Apparently their argument started over something to do with the washing-up.
distractors: Apparently their argument started over something to do with money.
Apparently their friendship started over something to do with the washing-up.

sentences.fr: Dès que j’aurai fini ce travail, je t’appellerai pour qu’on en discute.
sentences.en: As soon as I've finished this work, I'll call you so that we can talk it over.
distractors: As soon as I've finished this book, I'll call you so that we can talk it over.
As soon as I've finished this work, I'll write to you so that we can talk it over.

sentences.fr: Finalement, ce n’était qu’un malentendu : elle croyait que je parlais d’elle.
sentences.en: In the end, it was only a misunderstanding: she thought I was talking about her.
distractors: In the end, it was only a misunderstanding: she thought I was laughing at her.
In the end, it was only a misunderstanding: he thought I was talking about him.

lines.speaker: La cliente
lines.fr: Bonjour, j’ai commandé un manteau il y a trois semaines et je n’ai toujours rien reçu.
lines.en: Hello, I ordered a coat three weeks ago and I still haven't received anything.

lines.speaker: L’employé
lines.fr: Vous avez le numéro de commande ? Je vais vérifier ce qui s’est passé.
lines.en: Do you have the order number? I'll check what happened.

lines.speaker: La cliente
lines.fr: Le voici. On m’a dit au téléphone que le colis avait été livré vendredi.
lines.en: Here it is. I was told on the phone that the parcel had been delivered on Friday.

lines.speaker: L’employé
lines.fr: En effet, il a été livré chez votre voisin, au numéro 12.
lines.en: Indeed, it was delivered to your neighbour, at number 12.

lines.speaker: La cliente
lines.fr: Chez le voisin ? Personne ne m’a prévenue ! Je vais sonner chez lui ce soir.
lines.en: To the neighbour? Nobody told me! I'm going to ring his doorbell this evening.

lines.speaker: L’employé
lines.fr: Je suis désolé. Si vous ne le retrouvez pas, rappelez-nous et nous vous rembourserons.
lines.en: I'm sorry. If you don't find it, call us back and we'll refund you.

questions.question: Why has the customer come to the shop?
choices: She wants to exchange a coat that is too small
The coat she ordered has never reached her
She wants to order a coat for her neighbour
She wants to return a coat she does not like
questions.explanation: She says « j’ai commandé un manteau il y a trois semaines et je n’ai toujours rien reçu ».

questions.question: What does the employee find out about the parcel?
choices: It is still in the shop
It was sent back to the sender
It was delivered to her neighbour at number 12
questions.explanation: He says « il a été livré chez votre voisin, au numéro 12 ».

questions.question: When was the parcel delivered, according to the phone call?
questions.explanation: « le colis avait été livré vendredi ».

questions.question: What will the shop do if she does not find the parcel?
questions.explanation: « Si vous ne le retrouvez pas, rappelez-nous et nous vous rembourserons ».

passages.title: A complaint about the wrong neighbour

lines.speaker: Madame Robert
lines.fr: Julien, il faut que je vous parle : votre musique m’empêche de dormir depuis une semaine.
lines.en: Julien, I need to talk to you: your music has been stopping me sleeping for a week.

lines.speaker: Julien
lines.fr: Ma musique ? Je suis en déplacement depuis lundi et je suis rentré il y a une heure.
lines.en: My music? I've been away on a work trip since Monday and I got home an hour ago.

lines.speaker: Madame Robert
lines.fr: Pourtant le bruit vient bien du dessus, j’en suis certaine.
lines.en: Yet the noise really does come from above, I'm sure of it.

lines.speaker: Julien
lines.fr: Le studio au-dessus du mien est loué depuis peu à deux étudiants.
lines.en: The studio above mine has recently been rented to two students.

lines.speaker: Madame Robert
lines.fr: Je me suis trompée d’étage, alors. Excusez-moi, je suis vraiment confuse.
lines.en: I got the wrong floor, then. I'm sorry, I'm really embarrassed.

lines.speaker: Julien
lines.fr: Ce n’est rien. Si vous voulez, je leur en parlerai demain matin.
lines.en: It's nothing. If you like, I'll speak to them about it tomorrow morning.

questions.question: Why does Madame Robert come to see Julien?
choices: She wants to borrow some music
She thinks his music stops her sleeping
She wants to invite him for dinner
She wants him to repair her heating
questions.explanation: « votre musique m’empêche de dormir depuis une semaine ».

questions.question: Where has Julien been since Monday?
questions.explanation: « Je suis en déplacement depuis lundi et je suis rentré il y a une heure ».

questions.question: Who is really making the noise?
choices: Two students in the studio above Julien
questions.explanation: « Le studio au-dessus du mien est loué depuis peu à deux étudiants ».

questions.question: What does Julien offer to do?
choices: Speak to the students tomorrow morning
Move out at the end of the month
Turn his music down at night
questions.explanation: « Si vous voulez, je leur en parlerai demain matin ».

passages.title: The message meant for someone else

lines.speaker: Chloé
lines.fr: Marc, pourquoi est-ce que tu ne me réponds plus ? Tu es fâché contre moi ?
lines.en: Marc, why aren't you answering me any more? Are you angry with me?

lines.speaker: Marc
lines.fr: J’ai lu ton message hier : tu disais que tu ne supportais plus mes histoires.
lines.en: I read your message yesterday: you said you couldn't stand my dramas any more.

lines.speaker: Chloé
lines.fr: Ce message n’était pas pour toi ! Je l’ai envoyé par erreur.
lines.en: That message wasn't for you! I sent it by mistake.

lines.speaker: Marc
lines.fr: Il était pour qui, alors ?
lines.en: Who was it for, then?

lines.speaker: Chloé
lines.fr: Pour ma sœur. Elle me raconte les mêmes disputes depuis des mois.
lines.en: For my sister. She's been telling me about the same arguments for months.

lines.speaker: Marc
lines.fr: Tu aurais pu m’appeler tout de suite. J’ai passé une nuit horrible.
lines.en: You could have called me right away. I had a terrible night.

lines.speaker: Chloé
lines.fr: Tu as raison, je m’excuse. Je n’avais pas vu que tu l’avais lu.
lines.en: You're right, I'm sorry. I hadn't seen that you had read it.

questions.question: Why did Marc stop answering Chloé?
choices: He was away for a week
He was angry about a party
He read a message saying she couldn't stand his dramas
questions.explanation: « tu disais que tu ne supportais plus mes histoires ».

questions.question: Who was the message really meant for?
questions.explanation: « Pour ma sœur. Elle me raconte les mêmes disputes depuis des mois ».

questions.question: What does Marc reproach Chloé with?
choices: Talking about him to her sister
questions.explanation: « Tu aurais pu m’appeler tout de suite ».

questions.question: What had Chloé not realised?
choices: That Marc had read the message
questions.explanation: « Je n’avais pas vu que tu l’avais lu ».

passages.title: The wrong figures in the report

lines.speaker: Sofia
lines.fr: Karim, tu peux m’aider ? J’ai envoyé le rapport au client avec les chiffres de l’an dernier.
lines.en: Karim, can you help me? I sent the report to the client with last year's figures.

lines.speaker: Karim
lines.fr: Ne panique pas. Est-ce qu’il l’a déjà ouvert ?
lines.en: Don't panic. Has he already opened it?

lines.speaker: Sofia
lines.fr: Aucune idée. Je viens de m’en rendre compte, il y a deux minutes.
lines.en: No idea. I've just realised it, two minutes ago.

lines.speaker: Karim
lines.fr: Envoie-lui la bonne version tout de suite et explique-lui l’erreur honnêtement.
lines.en: Send him the right version right away and explain the mistake to him honestly.

lines.speaker: Sofia
lines.fr: Et si le patron l’apprend ?
lines.en: And what if the boss finds out?

lines.speaker: Karim
lines.fr: Il l’apprendra de toute façon. Il vaut mieux qu’il l’apprenne par toi.
lines.en: He'll find out anyway. It's better that he hears it from you.

questions.question: What mistake has Sofia made?
choices: She sent the report to the wrong client
She sent the report with last year's figures
She forgot to send the report
questions.explanation: « J’ai envoyé le rapport au client avec les chiffres de l’an dernier ».

questions.question: When did she notice the problem?
questions.explanation: « Je viens de m’en rendre compte, il y a deux minutes ».

questions.question: What does Karim tell her to do?
choices: Ask the boss to write to the client
Send the right version at once and explain the mistake
questions.explanation: « Envoie-lui la bonne version tout de suite et explique-lui l’erreur honnêtement ».

questions.question: Why should the boss hear it from Sofia?
choices: Because he is away this week
Because he will find out anyway
Because the client never reads reports
questions.explanation: « Il l’apprendra de toute façon. Il vaut mieux qu’il l’apprenne par toi ».

lines.fr: Bonjour Monsieur Lemoine, je vous écris au sujet de la fenêtre de la cuisine.
lines.en: Hello Mr Lemoine, I'm writing to you about the kitchen window.

lines.fr: Mon fils a joué au ballon dans l’appartement et la vitre s’est cassée samedi après-midi.
lines.en: My son played ball in the flat and the pane broke on Saturday afternoon.

lines.fr: Je suis vraiment désolée : j’aurais dû l’envoyer jouer dans le parc.
lines.en: I'm really sorry: I should have sent him to play in the park.

lines.fr: J’ai déjà appelé un vitrier, qui viendra jeudi matin, et je paierai la réparation moi-même.
lines.en: I've already called a glazier, who will come on Thursday morning, and I'll pay for the repair myself.

lines.fr: Pourriez-vous me confirmer que cela vous convient ? Merci d’avance et bonne journée.
lines.en: Could you confirm to me that this suits you? Thank you in advance and have a good day.

questions.question: How did the window get broken?
choices: A storm broke it during the night
Her son played ball inside the flat
questions.explanation: « Mon fils a joué au ballon dans l’appartement et la vitre s’est cassée ».

questions.question: When did it happen?
questions.explanation: « la vitre s’est cassée samedi après-midi ».

questions.question: Who will pay for the repair?
questions.explanation: « je paierai la réparation moi-même ».

questions.question: What does she ask the landlord to do?
choices: To confirm that this arrangement suits him
To lower the rent this month
questions.explanation: « Pourriez-vous me confirmer que cela vous convient ? ».

lines.fr: Léa, je pars très tôt ce matin, alors je te laisse ce mot sur la table.
lines.en: Léa, I'm leaving very early this morning, so I'm leaving you this note on the table.

lines.fr: La vaisselle traîne dans l’évier depuis mardi et je n’ai pas envie de me fâcher pour si peu.
lines.en: The washing-up has been lying in the sink since Tuesday and I don't want to get cross over such a small thing.

lines.fr: Je ne te demande pas de tout nettoyer : si chacun lave ses assiettes, ça ira très bien.
lines.en: I'm not asking you to clean everything: if each of us washes their own plates, it will be fine.

lines.fr: Moi non plus, je ne suis pas parfaite : j’ai oublié de sortir la poubelle deux fois cette semaine.
lines.en: I'm not perfect either: I forgot to take the bin out twice this week.

lines.fr: On en parle ce soir devant une pizza ? C’est moi qui invite.
lines.en: Shall we talk about it tonight over a pizza? It's my treat.

questions.question: Why does she leave a note instead of speaking to Léa?
choices: She is leaving very early this morning
She is too angry to speak
Léa is away for the week
questions.explanation: « je pars très tôt ce matin, alors je te laisse ce mot sur la table ».

questions.question: Since when has the washing-up been in the sink?
questions.explanation: « La vaisselle traîne dans l’évier depuis mardi ».

questions.question: What exactly does she ask of Léa?
choices: To take the bin out every day
questions.explanation: « Je ne te demande pas de tout nettoyer : si chacun lave ses assiettes, ça ira très bien ».

questions.question: What does she admit about herself?
choices: She broke a plate last week
She forgot to take the bin out twice
questions.explanation: « j’ai oublié de sortir la poubelle deux fois cette semaine ».

gloss.en: desire (avoir envie de = to feel like)

passages.title: Diary: I got angry too quickly

lines.fr: Hier, ma sœur a annulé notre déjeuner pour la troisième fois, sans même s’excuser.
lines.en: Yesterday, my sister cancelled our lunch for the third time, without even apologising.

lines.fr: Je lui ai écrit un message très dur, puis j’ai éteint mon téléphone toute la journée.
lines.en: I wrote her a very harsh message, then I switched my phone off all day.

lines.fr: Ce matin, j’ai compris : elle préparait une fête pour mes quarante ans avec mes collègues.
lines.en: This morning I understood: she was preparing a party for my fortieth birthday with my colleagues.

lines.fr: Si j’avais attendu un jour, je ne lui aurais pas dit toutes ces bêtises.
lines.en: If I had waited a day, I wouldn't have said all those silly things to her.

lines.fr: Je vais lui apporter des fleurs et lui demander pardon avant ce soir.
lines.en: I'm going to bring her flowers and ask her forgiveness before this evening.

questions.question: How many times had the lunch been cancelled?
questions.explanation: « ma sœur a annulé notre déjeuner pour la troisième fois ».

questions.question: What did the writer do after sending the message?
choices: She switched her phone off all day
She went to her sister's house
questions.explanation: « puis j’ai éteint mon téléphone toute la journée ».

questions.question: Why had the sister really cancelled?
choices: She was preparing a birthday party with the writer's colleagues
questions.explanation: « elle préparait une fête pour mes quarante ans avec mes collègues ».

questions.question: What does the writer plan to do?
choices: Bring flowers and ask for forgiveness before this evening
Wait for her sister to apologise first
questions.explanation: « Je vais lui apporter des fleurs et lui demander pardon avant ce soir ».

passages.title: A letter of complaint to a hotel

lines.fr: Madame, Monsieur, nous avons séjourné dans votre hôtel du 3 au 6 août, chambre 214.
lines.en: Dear Sir or Madam, we stayed in your hotel from 3 to 6 August, room 214.

lines.fr: La climatisation ne fonctionnait pas et il faisait plus de trente degrés dans la chambre.
lines.en: The air conditioning wasn't working and it was more than thirty degrees in the room.

lines.fr: Nous l’avons signalé deux fois à la réception, mais personne n’est venu réparer l’appareil.
lines.en: We reported it twice at reception, but nobody came to repair the unit.

lines.fr: Comme nous avions payé une chambre climatisée, nous demandons le remboursement d’une nuit.
lines.en: As we had paid for an air-conditioned room, we are asking for a refund of one night.

lines.fr: Sans réponse de votre part avant le 30 septembre, nous écrirons à une association de consommateurs.
lines.en: Without an answer from you before 30 September, we will write to a consumer association.

questions.question: What was the problem in the room?
choices: The air conditioning did not work
questions.explanation: « La climatisation ne fonctionnait pas et il faisait plus de trente degrés dans la chambre ».

questions.question: How many times did they report it?
questions.explanation: « Nous l’avons signalé deux fois à la réception ».

questions.question: What are they asking for?
choices: A refund for the whole stay
questions.explanation: « nous demandons le remboursement d’une nuit ».

questions.question: What will they do if they get no answer before 30 September?
choices: Publish a review on the internet
questions.explanation: « Sans réponse de votre part avant le 30 septembre, nous écrirons à une association de consommateurs ».

passages.title: Advice: your friend owes you money

lines.fr: Votre ami vous doit de l’argent depuis six mois et vous n’osez pas lui en parler.
lines.en: Your friend has owed you money for six months and you don't dare talk to him about it.

lines.fr: C’est normal : nous avons tous peur qu’une question d’argent abîme une amitié.
lines.en: That's normal: we are all afraid that a money matter may damage a friendship.

lines.fr: Écrivez-lui un message calme où vous rappelez la somme et proposez un remboursement chaque mois.
lines.en: Write him a calm message in which you remind him of the amount and suggest a repayment each month.

lines.fr: S’il refuse d’en discuter, le problème n’est plus l’argent, mais le respect qu’il vous doit.
lines.en: If he refuses to talk about it, the problem is no longer the money, but the respect he owes you.

lines.fr: Beaucoup de lecteurs nous écrivent qu’ils ont retrouvé leur amitié après une seule conversation honnête.
lines.en: Many readers write to us that they got their friendship back after a single honest conversation.

questions.question: How long has the friend owed the money?
questions.explanation: « Votre ami vous doit de l’argent depuis six mois ».

questions.question: What does the column advise the reader to do?
choices: Write a calm message with the amount and a monthly repayment
questions.explanation: « Écrivez-lui un message calme où vous rappelez la somme et proposez un remboursement chaque mois ».

questions.question: What does it mean if the friend refuses to discuss it?
choices: That he has no money left
That the real problem is respect, not money
That he has forgotten the sum
questions.explanation: « le problème n’est plus l’argent, mais le respect qu’il vous doit ».

questions.question: What do many readers report?
choices: They never got their money back
They got their friendship back after one honest conversation
questions.explanation: « ils ont retrouvé leur amitié après une seule conversation honnête ».
